mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate hiring and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 12-month rolling median.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) is rising above its 3-month moving average, it indicates a supportive monetary policy environment combined with strengthening industrial activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns on FEDFUNDS, INDPRO, and their interaction term over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank hawkishness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential construction sector, which reduces consumer wealth and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 380,000 million dollars and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.7% signals a contraction in consumer spending and labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 380000.0 and UNRATE > 4.7.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals the end of the monetary policy cycle, which triggers profit-taking and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 115.0 for two consecutive months signals robust manufacturing growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 115.0 for 2 consecutive months.
